script_text:
Air meets water, but Aquarius can leave Pisces cold.

Pisces is Neptune-ruled Water; Aquarius is Uranus-ruled Air, traditionally ruled by Jupiter and Saturn. They complement imagination and systems, yet closeness can feel confining.

Pisces’s Venus-style devotion wants fusion; Aquarius’s Mars-style drive wants freedom, so tenderness attracts, possessiveness repels. The Sun in early Libra opposes early Pisces on September 29, activating 7th House romance: desire spikes, but signals misfire.

Mercury in late Libra opposes later Pisces, so Pisces hears reassurance while Aquarius hears a challenge to competence. Whole-sign synastry: Aquarius in Pisces’s 10th House, Pisces in Aquarius’s 4th House; career and home collide.

Saturn, Aquarius’s traditional ruler, sits near 10° Aries, squaring 10° Aquarius; this lasts only if structure replaces control. Neptune in Aries occupies Pisces’s 2nd House: tech or nonprofit careers can thrive, but joint money needs concrete budgets.

Make or break: never use distance as compromise.
